xBRIEFInfo.description: Recut of #3900: pack-versus-guidance fail-closed verifiers, not a critic-confirmed skill.

narratives.Overview: The #3900 design-critique arc refuted a standalone critic-confirmed skill. Checks 1-3 become fail-closed task verifiers over a staged pack root. Check 1 consumes the C1 declaration. Checks 2 and 3 compose C3 and C2 rather than rebuilding them. Check 4 enumerates open consumer hard-stops by title classification and label only. Checks 5 and 6 are operator disclosure at the release decision point and do not auto-block.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting a tag, I want pack-versus-guidance defects to fail closed without an agent electing to run a skill.
narratives.Acceptance: Checks 1-3 are fail-closed verifiers over a staged pack root in task check and release pre-flight. Check 1 reuses the C1 resolver. Check 4 is title-and-label only. Checks 5-6 are disclosure and do not auto-block. Each verifier fails a mutated staged tree. 0.107.0-shaped packs fail; fixed deposits are clear.

items.title: Check 1 is a fail-closed task verifier that resolves the C1 declaration against staged pack output and reuses evaluateDepositClosure.
Check 2 composes C3 live-procedure target validation; do not rebuild the oracle.
Check 3 composes C2 semantic-single-source; do not rebuild the oracle.
Check 4 enumerates open consumer hard-stops by BLOCKER title classification and the adoption-blocker label only; never ingest issue bodies.
Checks 5 and 6 print operator-facing new-refusal and net-posture disclosure at the release decision point and do not auto-block a tag.
Each verifier fails against a deliberately mutated staged tree, and a 0.107.0-shaped pack reproduces the escaped class while a fixed deposit is clear.

acceptance.derived_reason: Issue #3900 recut acceptance is independently testable clauses, not shell commands.

clauses.text: Checks 1-3 exist as fail-closed verifiers over a staged pack root, composed into task check and the release pre-flight, each with a remediation line.
Check 1 resolves the C1 declaration against staged pack output, reusing the landed resolver.
The deterministic half of check 4 enumerates open consumer hard-stops by title classification and label only, consistent with #3713.
Checks 5 and 6 are produced as operator-facing disclosure at the release decision point, and do not auto-block.
Each verifier fails against a deliberately mutated staged tree, proving it is not vacuous.
Running the check set against published 0.107.0 reproduces the escaped defects; running it against a deposit with them fixed reports clear.
